# Third-party packaging material

This directory contains notices used only when packaging optional third-party
components. It does not contain an ASI loader binary.

`Ultimate-ASI-Loader-LICENSE.txt` is the upstream MIT license from
<https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader>. The release script can add
a user-supplied official x64 `dinput8.dll` build of Ultimate ASI Loader to a
separate, clearly labeled archive. The canonical release remains plugin-only.
